newsitem.title: SPAIN: Argentaria sells 29 pct Egyptian Extemisr.
newsitem.headline: Argentaria sells 29 pct Egyptian Extemisr.

text.p: Spain's Corp Bancaria de Espana (Argentaria) said on Thursday it had sold its 29 percent stake in Egyptian Bank Extemisr, earning capital gains of four billion pesetas.
"The sale is part of the group's global international strategy to restructure and re-order its stakes abroad," the bank said in a statement.

Argentaria said it had become a shareholder in the Egyptian bank, whose main shareholder is state group Bank Misr, in 1981, when Extemisr was created as a joint venture dedicated principally to corporate banking in the domestic market.

"The new international strategy of the group is based on concentrating efforts in those geographic areas that offer the greatest possibilities for growth and in which the clientele for Argentaria is interested," the group said in a statement.
